snippet.title: Rivage - Release Date Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4094660/Rivage/

A release date trailer for Rivage. Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
